test_title: RRB Group D 2025 (New Pattern) Official Mock Test
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is true about carbon compound combustion?

options.text: Needs more oxygen for complete combustion

solution:
The correct answer is __**Needs more oxygen for complete combustion.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Combustion of carbon compounds refers to the chemical reaction where carbon-based substances react with **oxygen** to produce energy in the form of heat and light.
 
• Complete combustion occurs when there is a sufficient supply of **oxygen**. It produces **carbon dioxide** and **water**, along with releasing maximum energy. Hence, statement 4 is correct.
 
• Incomplete combustion takes place when there is insufficient **oxygen**, leading to the formation of **carbon monoxide** and soot instead of carbon dioxide. This can also result in lesser energy production. Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.
 
• Carbon compounds burn only in the presence of **oxygen**. Without oxygen, the reaction cannot proceed, as oxygen is a key reactant in combustion. Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.
 
• Water is a common product of combustion for most hydrocarbons. When hydrogen atoms in the compound react with oxygen, they form **water** (H₂O). Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.
 
• ***Therefore, the correct answer is Needs more oxygen for complete combustion.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Complete Combustion:**

 
 
• Occurs in the presence of an adequate supply of **oxygen**. It produces maximum energy along with **carbon dioxide** and **water** as by-products.
 
• Examples include burning of fuels such as **methane** (CH₄) or other hydrocarbons in well-ventilated spaces.
 
• Chemical equation: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O + Energy.
 
 
 
• **Incomplete Combustion:**
 
 
• Occurs due to a lack of sufficient **oxygen**. It produces harmful substances such as **carbon monoxide** (CO) and **soot**.
 
• Chemical equation: CH₄ + O₂ → CO + H₂O + Energy.
 
• Incomplete combustion leads to pollution and is less energy-efficient compared to complete combustion.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• **Complete combustion** is commonly used in engines, power plants, and cooking applications for efficient energy utilization.
 
• **Incomplete combustion** is a major concern in poorly ventilated areas, leading to indoor air pollution and health risks.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Characteristics:**

 
 
• **Carbon monoxide (CO):** A dangerous gas produced during incomplete combustion. It is colorless, odorless, and can cause health problems like poisoning.
 
• **Energy output:** Complete combustion provides higher energy efficiency compared to incomplete combustion.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Impact:**
 
 
• **Incomplete combustion:** Contributes to air pollution and global warming due to the release of CO and soot.
 
• **Complete combustion:** Although cleaner, it can still contribute to greenhouse gas emissions through the production of CO₂.
